newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says Cambior to invest $1.1 bln in La Granja.
newsitem.headline: Peru says Cambior to invest $1.1 bln in La Granja.

text.p: Canada's Cambior Inc plans to invest $1.1 billion exercising its option to develop the La Granja copper project, Peru's privatization body COPRI said Monday.
COPRI did not say in what timeframe the Candian miner planned to make its investment but added that the company expected to start concentrates production in 2002 and cathode output in 2004.
Cambior had previously said it was seeking a partner to help finance a planned $800 million project to produce 250,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate from 2001.

Cambior's $25 million feasibility study at La Granja showed the deposit had 2.3 billion tonnes of mineral reserves graded at 0.59 percent copper using a cut-off grade of 0.4 percent copper, COPRI said in a statement.
COPRI said Friday Cambior had decided to exercise its option to develop the project after the firm acquired a five- year option on 100 percent of the state asset in 1994.
COPRI said Cambior estimated it would produce an annual 300,000 tonnes of fine copper -- 255,000 tonnes in concentrates and 45,000 tonnes in cathodes -- when the project is fully operational.
The company expects $600 million annual revenue in the first two years of production and $640 million starting in 2004, the privatization board said.

"This field has turned into a mega-project geared for the development of the north of the country," the statement said of La Granja, located in the Cajamarca department some 400 miles (640 kms) north of Lima.
In building the infrastructure for the project, Cambior plans to employ 2,500 people and have a workforce of 900 when its mine is operational, COPRI said.

The project involves creating highway access to the site, building 37.5 miles (60 km) of tailings pipelines as well as 170 miles (270 km) of concentrates pieplines that will connect La Granja with the coastal town of Bayovar, COPRI said. The company will have to provide some port facilities at Bayovar.
Once this infrastructure is in place, Cambior has said it hopes a partner will build a smelter for the copper La Granja produces.
